pages.howItWorksIntro: Hyrabostad brings together vacant rental homes from many landlords in one place and always links onward to the landlord's own application.
pages.howStep1Title: We read the landlords' own pages
pages.howStep1Body: Landlords connect a feed, an API or their public list of vacancies. Smaller landlords can publish homes directly in our portal.
pages.howStep2Body: Search by municipality or district, filter by rent, rooms, size and queue requirement. Every home shows when we last checked the source.
pages.howStep3Body: We handle no applications and charge nothing. The button on the listing page always leads to the landlord's own page or contact route.
pages.faq1A: No. The service is free for people searching and for landlords.
pages.faq2Q: Can I apply for a home here?
pages.faq2A: No. Applications always happen with the landlord. We link onward to the landlord's own application or show their contact route.
pages.faq3Q: How do I know a home is still available?
pages.faq3A: We show when we last read the landlord's page. The landlord decides whether the home is available, not us.
pages.faq4Q: Do you show every vacant rental home?
pages.faq4A: No. We show homes from the landlords we monitor. Every municipality page shows how many of the known landlords we monitor.
pages.faq5Q: Why is rent or queue requirement missing on some homes?
pages.faq5A: We show what the landlord publishes. When a detail is missing on the landlord's side we say it is missing rather than guess.
pages.contactIntro: Questions about the service, a home shown incorrectly, or a source you want removed? Write to us.
pages.contactLandlords: Are you a landlord? Read more on the landlord page.
pages.collectionIntro: How we collect, store and show information about vacant homes.
pages.collectionWhatBody: Factual details about vacant homes: address, area, rent, rooms, size, floor, contract type, move-in date, application deadline, queue requirement and the link to the landlord's own listing. We do not copy full descriptions and we do not store the landlord's photos.
pages.collectionHowBody: We prefer feeds and APIs that the landlord has connected themselves. When we read a web page we do so at ordinary traffic levels, one request at a time per host, and we obey robots.txt. Our requests identify themselves as Hyrabostad with a link to this page.
pages.collectionRemovalTitle: Removing a source or a home
pages.collectionRemovalBody: Landlords who do not want to appear here can contact us and we disable the source within five working days. A home that disappears from the landlord's site stops showing here at the next read.
pages.collectionRetentionBody: Raw data from reads is kept for at most 90 days for debugging. Details of removed homes are kept so that old links can show that the home is no longer available.
pages.privacyIntro: People searching need no account and we store no personal data about you when you search. Saved searches and homes are stored only in your browser.
pages.privacyLandlordsBody: When a landlord creates an account we store the contact person's name, email address and phone number. They are used to review the application, for sign-in and to notify about failures. The legal basis is contract and legitimate interest. The data is deleted when the account is closed.
pages.privacyListingsBody: Landlord contact routes shown on listing pages are details the landlord chose to publish. Contact us if you want a detail removed.
pages.cookiesIntro: Hyrabostad uses no tracking cookies and no third-party analytics on the public pages.
pages.cookiesNecessaryBody: Your language choice, saved searches and saved homes are stored in your browser. Signed-in landlords and staff get a session cookie required for sign-in.
pages.termsIntro: These terms apply to organisations that publish homes on Hyrabostad, directly in the portal or through a connected source. Draft: to be reviewed by the owner before launch.
pages.terms1Body: Accounts are open to housing companies, registered property owners and organisations with an organisation number. Every application is reviewed by hand and the account opens only after approval. Private individuals cannot publish.
pages.terms2Body: You confirm that you are entitled to publish the homes you add or connect, that the details are accurate and that you keep them up to date. You are responsible for the photos and texts you provide. We do not alter your details; when a detail is missing we show that it is missing.
pages.terms3Body: We show your homes in search with you named as the source and always link onward to your own application or contact route. We handle no applications, charge people searching nothing and do not charge you. Connected sources are read about once an hour.
pages.terms4Body: You can unpublish a home or disable a source at any time. We may remove homes or close accounts that break these terms, for example incorrect or misleading details, and will notify you at the contact person's email.
pages.terms5Body: The contact person's name, email and phone are processed as described on our personal data page. Details in listings are ones you chose to publish.
pages.terms6Body: We may update these terms. Material changes are announced by email to account owners at least 30 days before they take effect.
pages.privacyRetention: Rejected applications are deleted after 90 days and applications never decided after 180 days. An account owner can close the landlord account from the portal; the users are then deleted and the homes unpublished.
